description: AVA projects should preserve their native command, execution-context assertion evidence, and audit-first plan shape.

lockedFields.reason: The plan should preserve the package's AVA test script.
AVA dependency, config, command, and test-location signals provide high-confidence setup evidence.
The untested cart client should remain one add-test candidate.
The parser's existing AVA test should be extended rather than duplicated.
Existing parser coverage should remain the first review target.
Inline and assigned-result AVA execution-context assertions should remain explicit provenance.
The plan should reuse the existing AVA test location.
The untested external service boundary should receive a focused unit-test recommendation.

allowedVariations: Rationale wording may change while retaining the native AVA strategy.
Additional non-locked metadata may be added.
unexpectedVariations: Replacing the discovered npm test command.
Duplicating the existing parser test instead of extending it.
